description: This file defines the HorizontalYAxisRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering and formatting a horizontal Y axis in a chart, specifically for Bar2D charts, within the PDFsharp charting library.

classes.name: HorizontalYAxisRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing and formatting the horizontal Y axis in charts.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer info based on the Y axis of the chart.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates space requirements for the Y axis, including labels, title, and gridlines.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the Y axis, tick marks, labels, and title on the chart.

methods.name: InitScale
methods.description: Calculates scaling parameters such as min/max values and tick marks for the axis.

methods.name: GetTickMarkPos
methods.description: Determines the start and end positions for major and minor tick marks based on tick mark type.

methods.name: CalcYAxis
methods.description: Calculates the minimum and maximum Y values from all series in the chart.
